title: 第15章 天品五灵根第16章 自己吓自己
slug: 加入合欢宗后师妹的鱼塘炸了
content_zh:
第15章天品五灵根白日没吃饱，云洛偷偷带了两只猪蹄回去。
一只自己吃，一只给拽拽。
一人一兽啃得正欢，穆荷突然让她去一趟主峰面见白欢师祖。
她只好暴风吸食将剩下的猪蹄啃完，骑上迈巴鹤前往太和峰。
白欢没有住在主殿，而是在一处单独开辟的洞府，里面简单得只有一个蒲团和一张玉床。
此刻她已经换了身月白的法衣，盘坐在蒲团上，倒真有几分女菩萨的味道。
云洛上前行礼。
“弟子云洛拜见老祖。”
白欢凝视她片刻：“站过来些。”
云洛上前，在离她三尺远的地方停下。
“再过来些。”
她只得再上前一步，这个距离，能清晰看到对方脸上的皮肤纹理。
“可会素女心经？”
云洛点头：“会。”
《素女心经》是合欢宗自创的一种利用神魂交融达到双修效果的功法。
与一般的双修功法相比，素女心经不涉及阴阳调和，因此可同性间修炼。
这三年，云洛与褚璃、苏羡鱼，以及其他峰的师姐都炼过。
白欢了然：“现在，你同本尊修炼素女心经第一篇。”
云洛看了眼一旁的穆荷，见她点头，便盘腿坐下，屏息凝神。
白欢道：“将你的神魂放入我的识海。”

“是。”
云洛静心凝神，缓缓靠近白欢，像是1一般将自己的神魂探入对方识海。
白欢的识海无边无际，只是身临其中压迫感便让人心脏紧缩。
很快，她的神魂感觉到一阵温暖，像是被什么包裹住。
那是白欢的神魂，她看不见，或者说，这整片空间都是她的神魂。
“……合归一处结成丹，还为元始先天气……”
伴随着口诀的进行，两人的神魂开始交织，空气中浓郁的灵气丝丝缕缕涌入二人的身体，如润雨细无声，滋养着双方的丹田。
两个时辰后。
云洛双颊潮红，感受到自己的修为更加稳固，可那突破筑基的瓶颈始终未破。
“师祖，可看出什么了？”
穆荷紧张问向白欢。
白欢凝眉未作答，抬手将一股灵力探入云洛丹田，直达灵根的位置。
片刻过后，她眉心舒展，显而易见的愉悦。
“小荷啊小荷，你真是捡了个宝贝。”
云洛茫然，穆荷与澹台昭同样不解。
白欢起身，负手走了几步，看向云洛：
“你并非中品木灵根，而是天品五灵根。”
天品五灵根？
听她的语气，云洛不知该喜还是悲。
她只知道有多灵根的人，每多一条灵根，修炼所需的资源则要翻倍。

因此一般修士只会修炼其中一条，这样的结果便是会受未修炼灵根的影响，往往破境困难。
因为无法给到足够的资源，所以大宗门只会收单灵根的人。
“师祖，你可确定？”
content_en:
Chapter 15 Tianpin Wulinggen didn’t eat enough during the day, so Yunluo secretly took two pig trotters back.
One eats it by itself and the other pulls it.
One person and one beast were enjoying themselves, and Mu He suddenly asked her to go to the main peak to meet Master Bai Huan.
She had no choice but to eat up the remaining pig's trotters and ride on the Maiba Crane to Taihe Peak.
Bai Huan did not live in the main hall, but in a separate cave, which was as simple as a futon and a jade bed.
At this moment, she had changed into moon-white robes and was sitting cross-legged on the futon. She really looked like a female Bodhisattva.
Yunluo stepped forward and saluted.
"Disciple Yunluo pays homage to the ancestor."
Bai Huan stared at her for a moment: "Stand over."
Yunluo stepped forward and stopped three feet away from her.
"Come here more."
She had to take another step forward. From this distance, she could clearly see the skin texture on the other person's face.
"Do you know Su Nu's Heart Sutra?"
Yun Luo nodded: "Yes."
"Su Nu Heart Sutra" is a self-created exercise by the Hehuan Sect that utilizes the blending of soul and soul to achieve the effect of dual cultivation.
Compared with the general dual cultivation method, Su Nu Heart Sutra does not involve the reconciliation of yin and yang, so it can be practiced by people of the same sex.
In the past three years, Yunluo has practiced with Chu Li, Su Xianyu, and senior sisters from other peaks.
Bai Huan understood: "Now, you and I practice the first chapter of Su Nu's Heart Sutra."
Yun Luo glanced at Mu He beside him, and when he saw her nodding, he sat down cross-legged and held his breath.
Bai Huan said: "Put your soul into my sea of consciousness."
"Yes."
Yun Luo calmed down and slowly approached Bai Huan, as if he were like a human being, thrusting his soul into the opponent's sea of consciousness.
Bai Huan's sea of ​​consciousness is boundless, and just being in it makes one's heart tighten with the oppressive feeling.
Soon, her soul felt a warmth, as if it was wrapped in something.
That was Bai Huan's soul, which she couldn't see. In other words, this entire space was her soul.
"...Combined together to form an elixir, and bring back the innate Qi of the Yuan Dynasty..."
As the chant continued, the two souls began to intertwine, and the rich spiritual energy in the air poured into their bodies, like moist rain, nourishing the Dantian of both parties.
Two hours later.
Yun Luo's cheeks were flushed, and he felt that his cultivation was more stable, but the bottleneck of breaking through the foundation building had not yet been broken.
"Master, what can you see?"
Mu He asked Xiang Bai Huan nervously.
Bai Huan frowned and did not answer. He raised his hand and probed a stream of spiritual power into Yunluo's dantian, directly reaching the location of his spiritual root.
After a moment, her eyebrows relaxed, and she was obviously happy.
"Xiao He, Xiao He, you really picked up a treasure."
Yunluo was at a loss, and Mu He and Tantai Zhao were equally puzzled.
Bai Huan stood up, walked a few steps with his hands behind his hands, and looked at Yun Luo:
"You are not a middle-grade wood spirit root, but a heaven-grade five spirit root."
Tianpin Wulinggen?
Listening to her tone, Yunluo didn't know whether to be happy or sad.
She only knew that for people with multiple spiritual roots, for each additional spiritual root, the resources required for cultivation would be doubled.
Therefore, most monks will only practice one of them. As a result, they will be affected by uncultivated spiritual roots and often have difficulty breaking through.
Because they cannot provide enough resources, most sects will only accept people with single spiritual roots.
"Master, are you sure?"
